IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Economic Development, Agriculture & Trade.

Bill.BriefDescription: Eliminating the requirement for a seller's real estate disclosure of proximity to farming.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a seller's real estate disclosure of proximityto farming; and repealing RCW 64.06.022.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: RCW 64.06.022 (Disclosure of proximity tofarm or farm operation) and 2005 c 511 s 3 are each repealed.
